subject: Beyond the 75 signals
body:
Newsletter coverage is the layer under the intent you already sell, and it is specific: which publications wrote about an account, which sponsors buy space in them, which people and brands were named, and whether the list is rising.

NewsletterFIT derives those with AI from the newsletter ecosystem and serves them over REST and an MCP server, so they land as structured records with a source URL and date rather than text to interpret.

The category is measured in our graph already: Clay 92 articles across 56 publications, Apollo 102 across 88, ZoomInfo 25 across 19, Lusha 5, 6sense 12. Persana itself appears once.

I can send a sample for a segment you sell, shaped from the same fields, so you can compare it against your own output in one sitting.
